title: Fundamentals of Deep Learning
description: Learn how to train deep learning models for image classification and object detection from scratch. You will explore various network architectures and optimization techniques.

title: Getting Started with AI on Jetson Nano
description: An introduction to computer vision and AI using the Jetson Nano. Covers classification, regression, and data collection directly on the edge.

title: Building Transformer-Based NLP Applications
description: Master the architecture of Transformer models. Learn to build applications using BERT and other high-performance models for sentiment analysis and translation.

title: Accelerating End-to-End Data Science Workflows
description: Learn to use RAPIDS to significantly speed up your data science pipelines, from data loading to model training using multi-GPU systems.

title: Generative AI with Diffusion Models
description: Deep dive into the math and architecture behind Stable Diffusion. Learn to build and fine-tune latent diffusion models for creative AI applications.

title: Application Deployment with NVIDIA Triton
description: Focus on the DevOps side of AI. Deploy AI models at scale using the Triton Inference Server for multi-framework and high-throughput production.
